resources.title: NEET UG Result
resources.description: Official NTA NEET UG 2026 result and score-card portal
resources.latestUpdate: As of 21 September 2026, the NEET UG 2026 score card/result and final answer-key updates are available on the official NTA portal.

details.Admit Card: Available through the official NEET portal
details.Exam Date: 03 May 2026; re-examination for eligible candidates on 21 June 2026
details.Counselling: Counselling is handled by the respective counselling authorities after result declaration.
details.Eligibility: 10+2 / equivalent passed or appearing with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology and English, subject to the official NEET UG 2026 eligibility rules.
details.Age Limit: Minimum age 17 years by 31 December 2026; no upper age limit.
details.Application Fee: As prescribed in the NEET UG 2026 Information Bulletin; category-wise fee applies.
details.Exam Pattern: Pen-and-paper (OMR) examination; 200 questions are provided and 180 are to be attempted, for 720 marks.

details.Exam Pattern: Computer Based Test (CBT); Paper 1 for B.E./B.Tech. covers Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.

resources.title: GATE 2027
resources.description: Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras)

resources.title: NDA & NA Examination (II) 2026

details.Counselling: SSB selection process after written-result qualification.

details.Application Fee: ₹100; eligible female/SC/ST candidates and specified wards are exempt.
details.Exam Pattern: Written examination: Mathematics 300 marks and GAT 600 marks, followed by SSB Test/Interview.

resources.title: CDS II 2026
